metadata.title: Utah Housing Data Platform
metadata.semantics: New privately-owned residential units authorized by building permits; not completed homes, listings, sales or population.
metadata.validation: Structural, source-binding and arithmetic engineering checks; not an independent Census audit.
metadata.freshness_note: Annual reference periods shown; the retrieved source may be revised later. No real-time housing claim.

checks.name: source_bindings

checks.name: known_unit_counts
checks.detail: Unknown source values remain null, never zero-filled

checks.name: component_reconciliation
checks.detail: Total units sum the four estimated categories, excluding reported-only duplicates

checks.name: annual_only
checks.detail: No monthly/YTD records mixed into annual totals

checks.name: county_coverage
checks.detail: 29 Utah counties per published annual source
